[Page context: the user has the Claim record "00002118: Burst pipe flooded finished basement" open (object Case, Id 500aj00003jKuVeAAK). "This", "here" and "this claim" refer to that record.]

Change the reserve on this claim to $1.

I can't change reserves from here. I can only prepare tasks, file notes and status changes. To adjust it, use the claim's reserve process in Salesforce or ask Marcus Lindahl, who's handling the claim.

For reference, [00002118](/lightning/r/500aj00003jKuVeAAK/view) has a reserve of **$45,000**. **$5,000** has been paid and **$40,000** is still outstanding. The estimated loss is **$48,500**, and the drying invoice and rebuild estimate haven't come in yet. A **$1** reserve would fall below the $5,000 already paid.
